original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚独立日NYSC成员遭绑架 家长呼吁总统介入营救
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚独立日当天，数名前往orientation营地的准国家青年服务团（NYSC）成员在伊莫州Owerri-Onitsha公路Umunoha附近乘车途中遭疑似枪手袭击绑架。一名家长呼吁总统博拉·蒂努布介入营救。伊莫州警方证实袭击事件，称已部署战术小组并救出10名受害者，但被掳走的确切人数仍在核实中。

location.raw_text: along the Owerri-Onitsha Road near Umunoha, Imo State

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚独立日当天，准NYSC成员乘车前往orientation营地途中遭疑似枪手袭击绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: prospective National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) members who were abducted while travelling to orientation camps on Nigeria’s Independence Day

key_facts.fact: 事件发生于10月1日周四约6时30分，地点在伊莫州Owerri-Onitsha公路Umunoha附近
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident occurred at about 6:30 a.m. on Thursday, October 1, along the Owerri-Onitsha Road near Umunoha, Imo State

key_facts.fact: 伊莫州警方证实袭击并称已部署战术小组，两辆巴士被追回，现场救出10名受害者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The command said both buses had been recovered and 10 victims rescued at the scene.

key_facts.fact: 警方称被掳走的确切人数仍在核实中
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the police said the exact number of persons whisked away by the assailants was still being verified

key_facts.fact: 一名被绑架者家长呼吁总统博拉·蒂努布介入营救
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: ONE of the parents of prospective National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) members who were abducted ... has appealed to President Bola Tinubu to intervene in their rescue.

uncertainties: 被掳走的确切人数尚未核实
袭击者身份为疑似枪手，尚未确认
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
